title: Law to boost outreach for underused minority- and women-owned businesses
summary: This bill would require City agencies that fail to meet their minority- and women-owned business enterprise (M/WBE) utilization goals to conduct targeted outreach and education for the underused M/WBE categories. Agencies would work with the Office of Ethnic and Community Media and community-based organizations to inform businesses about certification and contracting opportunities. The bill also makes technical fixes to numbering in the Administrative Code's contracts chapter and would take effect 90 days after becoming law.
